check2.rule: The adoption date is the earliest of the instruction file, an AI co-author line, and an agent author. Pass if at least 16 of 20 flagged projects have a co-author, agent author, or strict tool mention on or after that date, and at least 80% of projects that have both an adoption date and a co-author or agent-author date are within 92 days, with at least 10 such dates. A project with no co-author and no agent author has a missing gap, not a gap of zero. Commit-message mentions do not set the date.

check2_note: - Check 2 is a fresh sample, seed 20261111. It excludes the 40 repositories in `check2_development_sample.csv`. The adoption date is the earliest instruction file, AI co-author line, or agent author. The gap is measured to the earliest co-author or agent author. An earlier commit-message mention does not move the date, and a project with no co-author or agent author keeps a blank gap.
